newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot electricity prices rise again with gas.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot electricity prices rise again with gas.

text.p: Bulk wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were up slightly again Wednesday, mirroring a rise in spot natural gas prices, brokers and marketers said.
ERCOT power prices have risen steadily through the week in tandem with strong natural gas prices.
Peak, firm electricity in ERCOT for Thursday delivery was talked steady to higher at $27.00-30.00 from near $28.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) on Tuesday, the sources said.
Off-peak ERCOT power for Tuesday delivery was talked steady at close to $21.00 per MWh, the sources said.

November peak ERCOT power was discussed higher at $24.00-26.00 from a Tuesday discussion range of $22.50-23.30, while December peak power was said to be offered at $24.50 from a Tuesday range of $22.75-23.00, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
